title: CVQA: Culturally-diverse Multilingual Visual Question Answering Benchmark

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the zero-shot accuracy of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) on a culturally diverse Visual Question Answering (VQA) benchmark comprising images and cultural knowledge specific to 30 different countries.
Comparing the accuracy of MLLMs on visual question answering tasks when queried with prompts in English versus 31 different local and underrepresented languages.
